title: Every conversation, a clear next step
summary: An illustrative messaging workflow that answers common questions, captures useful details, and gives the right person the next step.
challenge: A growing business receives similar questions across social messages and email. People repeat answers, copy details into spreadsheets, and lose track of conversations that need follow-up.
approach: Connect eligible messaging channels to a shared workflow. Use approved information for replies, collect inquiry details, update the customer record, and assign exceptions to a person with the full conversation attached. Channel access and reply rules are checked during discovery.
outcome: The proposed system gives every inquiry a visible owner and status. The goal is less copying, more consistent responses, and a clear handoff whenever a person is needed. These are intended benefits of the concept, not measured client results.
